# 1 Enoch Chapter 99 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 99:1 — 'act impiously' vs. 'live as though God doesn't exist'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "ye-who-act-impiously" | Literal; 'impiously' is precise |
| LOGOS | "you who act impiously" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "you who live as though God doesn't exist" | Interprets 'impiety' functionally |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'act impiously.' PNEUMA's interpretation, while illuminating, adds words not present in the Ge'ez.

---

## 99:2 — 'transform themselves into what they were not'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "transform-themselves-into-what-they-were-not" | Literal; may refer to apostasy or moral transformation |
| LOGOS | "transform themselves into what they were not" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "remake themselves into something they were never meant to be" | 'Never meant to be' adds teleological interpretation |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA's 'never meant to be' imports a teleological claim not present in the Ge'ez.

---

## 99:3 — Prayers as memorial/testimony

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "raise-your-prayers-as-a-memorial" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "lift your prayers as a memorial" | 'Lift' is more dynamic |
| PNEUMA | "Lift your prayers up as a living record" | 'Living record' adds to 'memorial' |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'lift your prayers as a memorial.' 'Living record' (PNEUMA) is interpretive. The word 'memorial' (Ge'ez: zekara) is a technical term with priestly/liturgical resonance (cf. Numbers 5:15; 10:10) that should be preserved.

---

## 99:5 — Abandonment of nursing infants

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "abandon-their-children-that-are-still-sucklings" | Literal: 'sucklings' = nursing infants |
| LOGOS | "abandon their children who are still nursing" | Formal; 'nursing' more natural |
| PNEUMA | "abandon infants still at the breast" | More vivid; 'at the breast' is idiomatic |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'still nursing.' Both LOGOS and PNEUMA are clear; 'nursing' is slightly more accessible while preserving the physiological reality.

---

## 99:13 — 'bricks and stones of sin' — construction metaphor

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "bricks-and-stones-of-sin" | Literal; sin as building material |
| LOGOS | "bricks and stones of sin" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "where every brick and stone is made of exploitation" | 'Exploitation' interprets 'sin' specifically |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'bricks and stones of sin.' 'Sin' is the Ge'ez term; 'exploitation' (PNEUMA) over-specifies. The chapter already provides context — 'sin' here is deliberately broad.

---

## 99:16 — 'arouse His fierce indignation'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "He-will-arouse-His-fierce-indignation" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "He will arouse His fierce indignation" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "He will unleash his fierce wrath" | 'Unleash' is vivid; 'wrath' for 'indignation' |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'arouse His fierce indignation.' 'Indignation' preserves the nuance of righteous anger provoked by injustice, distinct from 'wrath' (which may imply impulsive emotion).

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 6**
